title: Affected economic and public sectors
description: Broad sectors used to connect contextual events with affected systems and agricultural impacts.

terms.label: Agriculture
terms.definition: Primary cultivation, animal production and associated farm activity.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include farm-level and primary agricultural production; classify processing under FOOD_AND_BEVERAGE.

terms.label: Food and beverage
terms.definition: Processing, manufacturing, distribution and sale of food and beverage products.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include post-farm food systems and processing; exclude primary farm production unless separately classified.

terms.label: Fisheries
terms.definition: Capture fisheries, aquaculture and related primary aquatic production.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include harvest and farming of aquatic organisms; exclude general marine conservation without a production dimension.

terms.label: Forestry
terms.definition: Management, harvest and primary production of forests and forest resources.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include productive forestry; exclude conservation-only matters unless forestry operations are affected.

terms.label: Energy
terms.definition: Production, transmission, distribution and sale of fuels and power.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include energy industries and utilities; exclude energy use that is only incidental to another sector.

terms.label: Water
terms.definition: Water supply, treatment, allocation and utility services.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include managed water systems; use agriculture domains additionally for irrigation-specific impacts.

terms.label: Healthcare
terms.definition: Human health services, pharmaceuticals and health-system operations.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include delivery and supply of healthcare; exclude population health conditions without sector impact.

terms.label: Transport and logistics
terms.definition: Movement, storage and handling of people and goods.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include transport operators, ports, warehousing and distribution; exclude infrastructure construction alone.

terms.label: Financial services
terms.definition: Banking, insurance, investment, payments and other financial intermediation.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include financial institutions and services; exclude economy-wide monetary conditions without sector-specific effects.

terms.label: Manufacturing
terms.definition: Industrial transformation of raw materials into manufactured goods.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include non-food industrial production; classify food processing under FOOD_AND_BEVERAGE.

terms.label: Construction
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include construction operations and contractors; exclude completed infrastructure operations.

terms.label: Technology
terms.definition: Digital, computing, electronics and technology-product industries.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include technology providers and products; use technology categories for the particular technical family.

terms.label: Telecommunications
terms.definition: Communication networks, connectivity providers and related services.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include telecom operators and networks; exclude general software services without a connectivity function.

terms.label: Public administration
terms.definition: Operational institutions and services of government.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include government administration as an affected sector; use politics and governance for political context.

terms.label: Retail
terms.definition: Sale of goods and services directly to final consumers.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include consumer-facing commerce; classify food-specific retail additionally under FOOD_AND_BEVERAGE.

terms.label: Tourism and hospitality
terms.definition: Travel, accommodation, visitor services and hospitality operations.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include tourism and hospitality demand or operations; exclude ordinary transport unrelated to visitors.

terms.label: Education
terms.definition: Schools, universities, training and formal learning services.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include educational institutions and delivery; classify research institutions separately as organizations when appropriate.

terms.label: Mining
terms.definition: Extraction and primary processing of minerals and geological resources.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include mining operations and mineral supply; exclude oil and gas classified under ENERGY.
